detail: Marwadi Chandarana Intermediaries Brokers Private Limited initiated an open offer to acquire shares of TruCap Finance Limited. The Securities Appellate Tribunal issued an interim order in the matter; the order was formally submitted to NSE by Sundae Capital Advisors Private Limited (merchant banker/advisor). The interim order likely addresses procedural, valuation, or eligibility questions that arose during the offer process. The filing of the interim SAT order on the exchange indicates the acquirer and target are adhering to disclosure norms under SEBI takeover regulations.
